pages.excerpt: The**Ministry of the Presidency, Justice and Relations with the Cortes**is a[department](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spanish_government_departments)in the[Government of Spain](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Government_of_Spain)responsible for providing political and administrative support to the[Prime Minister](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Prime_Minister_of_Spain)and his[staff](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Office_of_the_Prime_Minister_(Spain)), to the[Royal Household](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Royal_Household_of_Spain), as well as managing the relations between the[Government](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Government_of_Spain)and the[Cortes Generales](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cortes_Generales)(Parliament). Likewise, it is also responsible for coordinating constitutional affairs and for designing, implementing and monitoring the government's legislative program.[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ministry_of_the_Presidency,_Justice_and_Relations_with_the_Cortes#cite_note-:0-
